verses.text: And it was in the thirtieth year—on the fourth {month}, on the fifth day of the month—and I {was} among the exiles along the river of Kebar. The heavens opened, and I saw visions of God.
On the fifth {day} of the month—it {was} the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—
the word of Yahweh, being, was to Ezekiel, son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans on the river of Kebar. And it was on him there, the hand of Yahweh.

Then I saw, and behold, a wind of storm, coming from the north, a great cloud and fire, catching itself. And brightness {was} to it all around, and from the midst of it {was} like the eye of metal from the midst of the fire.
And in the midst of it {was} the likeness of four beings. And this {was} their appearance—the likeness of a man {belonged} to them,
but four faces {belonged} to each one, and four wings {belonged} to each one of them.
And their two feet {were} straight feet, but a palm of their two feet {were} like a palm of a foot of a calf and gleaming like an eye of polished bronze.
And his hand {was} a man, from under their wings on four of their four sides. And their faces and their wings of the four of them—
their wings were each joining to its sister; they did not turn as they went; each went toward his faces.

And the likeness of their faces: the face of a man, and the face of a lion to the right {belonged} to the four of them, and the face of an ox from the left {belonged} to the four of them, and the face of an eagle {belonged} to the four of them.
So, their faces. And their wings were spread from above. Of each {one}, two were joining each, and two were covering their bodies.
And each {one}, its face went forward. Toward wherever the spirit was there to go, they went; they did not turn as they went.

And the likeness of the beings—their appearance {was} like coals of burning fire, like the appearance of torches. It {was} moving about between the beings and {was} a brightness of the fire, and, from the fire, lightning was coming forth.
And the beings, by running and returning, {were} like the appearance of the lightning strike.
Then I saw the beings, and behold, one wheel on the ground beside the beings, of four of its faces.

The appearance of the wheels and their works {was} like an eye of topaz, and the likeness of one {belonged} to the four of them. And their appearance and their works—it was just like the wheel in the midst of the wheel.
Toward four of their sides, when they went, they went; they did not turn when they went.
And their rims—and height {belonged} to them, and fear {belonged} to them. And the rims {were} full of eyes all around of the four of them.
And when the beings went, the wheels went beside them. And when the beings rose from on the ground, the wheels rose.
Toward wherever the spirit was there to go, they went—the spirit {was} there to go. And the wheels ascended beside them, for the spirit of the beings {was} in the wheels.
When they went, they went; and when they stood, they stood; and when they ascended from on the ground, the wheels ascended beside them, because the spirit of the beings {was} in the wheels.
And the likeness over the heads of the beings {was} a vault, like the eye of the fearsome ice, being stretched over their heads from above.
And under the vault, their wings {were} straight, each to its sister. Of each, two were covering themselves; and of each, two were covering themselves, their bodies.

Then, I heard the sound of their wings—like a sound of many waters, like a sound of the Almighty when they moved, like a sound of a crowd, like a sound of an army. When they stood, their wings slackened.
And it was, a voice from above the dome that {was} over their head; when they stood, their wings slackened.

And from above the vault that {was} over their head, like the appearance of a stone of sapphire, {was} the likeness of a throne, and on the likeness of the throne {was} a likeness, like the appearance of a man on it from above.

And I saw {something} like the eye of metal, like the appearance of fire—a house {belonged} to it all around—from the appearance of his waist and upwards. And from the appearance of his waist and downward, I saw {something} like the appearance of fire. And brightness {belonged} to it all around,

like the appearance of a rainbow that is in a cloud on a day of the rain. Thus {was} the appearance of the brightness all around. It {was} the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Yahweh. And I saw, and I fell on my face, and I heard a voice speaking.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, stand on your feet, so that I might speak to you.”
And the Spirit entered into me when he spoke to me, and it made me stand on my feet. Then I heard {one} speaking to me.

And he said to me, “Son of man, I am sending you to the sons of Israel, to rebellious nations that have rebelled against me. They and their fathers have revolted against me up to the bone of this day.
And the sons {are} hard of face and strong of heart. I am sending you to them, and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh.’
But they—whether they listen or whether they refuse, for a house of rebellion {are} they—but they will know that a prophet is in their midst.

But you, son of man—you shall not fear because of them, and because of their words, you shall not fear. Even though briers and thorns {are} to you, and with scorpions you are dwelling—because of their words, you shall not fear; and from their faces you shall not be dismayed, for they {are} a house of rebellion.
But you will speak my words to them—whether they listen or whether they refuse, because they are a rebellion.
But you, son of man, listen to that which I am speaking to you. You shall not be rebellious, like the house of rebellion. Open your mouth, and eat that which I am giving to you.”
And I saw, and behold, a hand was being sent to me. And behold, in it, a scroll of writing.
And he spread it out before me, and it was written, face and back, and written on it were laments and mourning and woe.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, that which you have found, eat. Eat that scroll, and go, speak to the house of Israel.”
So I opened my mouth, and he made me eat that scroll.
And he said to me, “Son of man, you shall make your belly eat, and you shall fill your stomach {with} that scroll that I am giving to you.” So I ate it, and it was, in my mouth, like honey—sweet.
And he said to me, “Son of man, come; go to the house of Israel, and you shall speak with my words to them,
for not to a people deep of lip and heavy of tongue are you being sent, {but} to the house of Israel—
not to many peoples, deep of lip or heavy of tongue, that you do not hear their words. Surely, not to them did I send you. They, they would have listened to you.
But the house of Israel will not be willing to listen to you, for they are not willing to listen to me, for all the house of Israel—they {are} strong of forehead and hard of heart.
Behold! I have made your face strong as beside their faces and your forehead hard as beside their foreheads.
As a thorn harder than flint, I have made your forehead. You shall not fear them, and you shall not be dismayed from their faces, for they {are} a house of rebellion.”
And he said to me, “Son of man, all the words that I am speaking to you—take {them} into your heart, and, in your ears, listen {to them}.
And come, go to the exiles, to the sons of your people, and you shall speak to them, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh,’ whether they listen or whether they refuse.”
Then the Spirit lifted me, and I heard behind me a sound of a great earthquake—“Blessed be the glory of Yahweh from his place!”—
and the sound of the wings of the living beings, each brushing its sister, and the sound of the wheels beside them, and a sound of a great earthquake.
And the Spirit lifted me and took me, and I went bitterly in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of Yahweh was strong on me.
So I came to the exiles {at} Tel Aviv, the ones dwelling along the river of Kebar, and who were sitting there. And I sat there {for} seven days, appalled in their midst.
And it was, {at} the end of seven days, and it was, the word of Yahweh {was} to me, saying,
“Son of man, a watchman I have made you for the house of Israel. So you shall hear a word from my mouth, and you shall warn them from it.

When I say to the wicked, ‘You will certainly die,’ and you do not warn him, and you do not speak to warn {the} wicked from his wicked way, so that he might live—he, wicked, he will die in his iniquity, but his blood from your hand I will seek.
But you—when you warn {the} wicked, and he does not turn from his wickedness or from his wicked way, he, he will die in his iniquity; but you—your life you will have rescued.

But when {the} righteous turns from his righteousness and does injustice, and I put an obstacle before him, he, he will die. If you did not warn him, in his sin he will die, and his righteousness that he did will not be remembered but his blood from your hand I will seek.
But you—when you warn him, {the} righteous—without sinning {is} {the} righteous, and he, he does not sin, his life will be, because he was warned. But you—your life you will have rescued.”
So, on me there was the hand of Yahweh. And he said to me, “Rise! Go out to the valley, and there I will speak {to} you.”
I arose, and I went out to the valley, and behold!—there, the glory of Yahweh was standing, like the glory that I saw along the river of Kebar. And I fell on my face.
Then the Spirit came into me, and it made me stand on my feet. And he spoke {to} me, and he said to me, “Go, shut yourself in the midst of your house.
But you, son of man—behold! They will put on you ropes, and they will bind you with them, and you will not go out in their midst.
And your tongue, I will make cling to your palate, and you will be mute, and you will not be to them, to a man, a reprover, for they {are} a house of rebellion.

And when I speak {to} you, I will open your mouth, and you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh!’ The {one} hearing will hear; the {one} refusing will refuse, for they are a rebellious house!”
“But you, son of man, take for yourself a brick, and you shall put it before you. Then you shall inscribe on it a city, Jerusalem.

Then, you shall place a siege against it, and you shall build siegeworks against it, and you shall pour out a mound against it. And you shall place camps against it, and you shall put battering rams against it, all around.

But you—take for yourself a griddle of iron, and you shall put it {as} a wall of iron, between you and between the city. Then you shall make firm your face to it, and it will be in the siege, and you shall lay siege against it. A sign {is} this for the house of Israel.
But you—lie on your left side, and you shall put the iniquity of the house of Israel on it. {For} the number of days that you shall lie on it, you will carry their iniquity.
And I myself will give to you the years of their iniquity {as} the number of days: 390 days. And you shall carry the iniquity of the house of Israel.

And {when} you have completed these {days}, then you shall lie on your right side a second time, and you shall carry the iniquity of the house of Judah: 40 days—a day for a year, a day for a year, I give to you.
And to the siege of Jerusalem, you shall make firm your face, and your arm bared. And you shall prophesy against it.
And behold!—I am putting on you ropes, and you will not turn from your side to your side until you have completed the days of your siege.

But you—take for yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and rye, and you shall put them in one vessel, and you shall make them for yourself into bread {for} the number of the days that you are lying on your side—390 days, you shall eat it.
And your food that you will eat {shall be}, by weight, twenty shekels per day. From time to time, you shall eat it.
And water—by measure, you shall drink a sixth {of} a hin. From time to time, you shall drink.
And a cake of barley, you shall eat it. But it—in the dung of the excrement of man, you shall bake it to their eyes.”
And Yahweh said, “Like thus, the sons of Israel will eat their unclean bread among the nations that I will banish them there.”
But I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Behold! My life has not been made unclean, and carcass or carrion I have not eaten, from my youth until now, and meat of defilement has not entered into my mouth!”
And he said to me, “Look—I am giving to you the droppings of cattle instead of the excrement of man. And you shall make your bread over them.”
And he said to me, “Son of man—behold me, breaking the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and with anxiety; and water, by measure and in horror, they will drink,
because they will lack bread and water. A man and his brother will be dismayed, and they will rot in their iniquity.”

“But you, son of man—take for yourself a sharp sword. {As} a knife of the barbers, you shall take it for yourself, and you shall pass {it} over your head and over your beard. And you shall take for yourself balances of weight, and you shall divide them.

A third, you shall burn in the fire in the midst of the city when the days of the siege are full. And you shall take the third, and you shall strike {it} with the sword all around it, and the third you shall scatter to the wind, and a sword I will empty after them.
But you shall take from there a small {amount} in number, and you shall bind them on your {two} edges.
And some of them you shall again take, and you shall throw them into the midst of the fire, and you shall burn them in the fire. From it, a fire will go out to all the house of Israel.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘This {is} Jerusalem; in the midst of the nations, I have placed her, and all around her {are} lands.

But she has rebelled {against} my judgments with wickedness more than the nations, and {against} my statutes more than the lands that {are} all around her. For they have rejected my judgments, and my statutes—they have not walked in them.’

Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘Because of your arrogance, more than the nations that {are} all around you—in my statutes, you have not walked, and my judgments you have not done, and according to the customs of the nations that {are} all around you, you have not done’—
therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘Look {at} me, against you—even me! And I will do judgments in your midst to the eyes of the nations.
And I will do with you that which I have not done and that which I will not do like it again, on account of all your abominations.
Therefore, fathers will eat sons in your midst, and sons will eat their fathers. And I will do with you judgments, and I will sow all your remainder to every wind.

Therefore, the life {of} me’—a declaration of the Lord Yahweh—‘certainly because my sanctuary you have made unclean with all your abhorrences and with all your abominations, and so I myself will reduce, and my eye will not have pity, and even I myself will not spare.

A third of you by the plague will die, or by the famine they will be finished in your midst. And a third by the sword will fall all around you. And a third to every wind I will scatter, and a sword I will empty after them.
Then my nose will be finished, and I will pacify my heat among them, and I will soothe myself. Then they will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my jealousy when I have completed my heat among them.
And I will make you into a desolation and into a reproach among the nations that {are} all around you, to the eyes of everyone passing by.

So it will become a reproach and a taunt, a warning and a horror to the nations that {are} all around you, when I do among you my judgments with nose and with heat and with reprimands of heat. I, Yahweh, have spoken!

When I send out the disastrous arrows of the famine among them—which will become destruction, which I will send them to destroy you—then I will increase the famine against you, and I will break for you {the} staff of bread.
So I will send against you famine and disastrous creatures, and they will bereave you, and plague and blood will pass through you, and a sword I will bring against you. I, Yahweh, have spoken!’”
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face to the mountains of Israel and prophesy to them.

And you shall say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! Thus says the Lord Yahweh to the mountains and to the hills, to the streambeds and to the valleys, “Look {at} me! I am bringing against you a sword, and I will destroy your high places.
Then your sacrificial altars will become desolate, and your incense altars will be broken. And I will throw down your slain in front of your idols.
I will place the corpses of the sons of Israel in front of their idols, and I will scatter your bones all around your sacrificial altars.

In all your dwellings, the cities will dry up, and the high places will be desolate, so that your sacrificial altars will be dried up and desolate. Then your idols will be broken and disappear, and your incense altars will be hewn, and your works will be annihilated.
And the slain will fall in your midst, and you will know that I {am} Yahweh.
But I will reserve {some}, when you become survivors of a sword among the nations, when you are scattered among the lands.

Then your survivors will remember me among the nations where they were deported there—that I was shattered {by} their heart, the prostituting {one}, which turned away from me, and {by} their eyes, the ones prostituting after their idols. Then they will feel loathing in their faces toward the evils that they did by all their abominations.
And they will know that I {am} Yahweh. {It was} not for nothing {that} I spoke to do to them this disaster.”

Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Strike with your palms and stomp with your foot! And say, ‘Ah!’ toward all the abominations of the evils of the house of Israel! For by the sword, by the famine, and by the plague, they will fall.

The remote {one}—by the plague, he will die; and the near {one}—by the sword, he will fall; and the remaining {one} and the spared {one}—by the famine, he will die. So I will complete my heat among them.

Then you will know that I {am} Yahweh, when their slain are in the midst of their idols, all around their sacrificial altars, on every high hill—on all the tops of the mountains and under every green tree and under every leafy oak—the place where they gave there a scent of pleasing to all of their idols.

And I will stretch out my hand against them, and I will make the land a desolation and a devastation—from the wilderness to Diblah, throughout every dwelling. And they will know that I {am} Yahweh.”’”
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,
“And you, son of man—thus says the Lord Yahweh to the land of Israel, ‘End! The end has come to the four edges of the land.
Now, the end {is} upon you, and I am sending my nose on you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will place on you all of your abominations.
And my eyes will not pity you, and I will not spare {you}. Certainly, I will place your ways on you, and your abominations will be in your midst. Then you will know that I {am} Yahweh.’
Thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘Disaster after disaster! Behold! It is coming.
An end comes! The end comes! It has awoken against you. Behold! It is coming!
Doom is coming to you, the ones dwelling {in} the land. The time has come! The day {is} near— panic and not shouts {on the} mountains.
Now, from near, I will pour my heat against you, and I will complete my nose on you. And I will judge you according to your ways, and I will place on you all your abominations.
And my eyes will not pity, and I will not spare. According to your ways, I will place on you, and your abominations will be in your midst. Then you will know that I {am} Yahweh—{the one} smiting!
Behold! The day! Behold! It is coming! Doom has gone out! The rod has blossomed; arrogance has budded!
Violence has gone up into a rod of wickedness. None {will be} of them— and none of their crowd, and none of their wealth, and no prominence of theirs!
The time is coming; the day has struck! Let not the buyer rejoice, and let not the seller mourn, for wrath {is} toward her whole crowd!
For the seller—to the sale, he will not return while they are yet alive, because {the} vision regarding the whole crowd will not return; and each one, in his iniquity, will not grasp his life.
They have blown the trumpet, and they have established everything, but there is no one going to war, for my wrath {is} toward her whole crowd.
The sword {is} outside, and the plague and the famine—from the house. The one in the field—by the sword, he will die; and the one in the city—famine and plague will consume him.
But their survivors will escape, and they will be toward the mountains. Like doves of the valleys, all of them will moan— each {one} in his iniquity.
All the hands will sink, and all knees will go {with} water.
And they will wear sackcloth, and horror will cover them; and to every face—shame, and on all of their heads—baldness!

Their silver they will throw outside, and their gold will be like menstruation. Their silver and their gold will not be able to rescue them on the day of the rage of Yahweh. Their throats will not be satiated, and their bellies will not be filled, because {it} is an obstacle of their iniquity.
And the beauty of his jewelry—he set it as pride, and the images of their abominations, their abhorrences, they made with it. Therefore, I have put {it} to them as menstruation.
Then I will give {it} into the hand of foreigners as plunder and to the wicked of the earth as spoil, and they will defile it.
And I will turn my face from them, and they will defile my treasured {place}. And violent {people} will enter into it, and they will defile it.
Make a chain, for the land {is} full of {the} judgment of blood, and the city {is} full of violence.
So I will bring the evils of the nations, and they will inherit their houses, and I will cease the pride of the mighty, and their sanctuaries will be defiled.
Terror is coming! Then they will seek peace, but none will be!
Disaster on disaster will come, and rumor to rumor will be. Then they will seek a vision from a prophet, but the instruction will perish from a priest, and the counsel from elders.

The king will mourn, and the prince will wear desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be terrified. From their ways, I will do to them, and by their judgments, I will judge them. And they will know that I am Yahweh.’”

And it was, in the sixth year, in the sixth {month}, on the fifth of the month, I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting to my face. And the hand of the Lord Yahweh fell on me there.

And I looked, and behold!—a likeness like the appearance of fire. From the appearance of his waist and downward {was} fire, and from his waist and upward {was} like the appearance of brightness, like the eye of the metal.

And he sent out the form of a hand, and he took me by a lock of my head. Then a wind lifted me between the earth and between the heavens, and it brought me to Jerusalem in visions of God, to the entrance of the gate of the inner {court}, the one opening northward, where there {was} the seat of the image of jealousy, the one provoking jealousy.
And behold! There {was} the glory of the God of Israel, like the appearance that I saw in the valley.

Then he said to me, “Son of man, now lift your eyes {to} the way of the north.” So I lifted my eyes {to} the way of the north, and behold!—from the north of the gate of the altar {was} this image of jealousy at the entrance.

Then he said to me, “Son of man, are you seeing what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Israel is doing here, to make {me} far from upon my sanctuary? But you will yet return; you will see great abominations.”
Then he brought me to the entrance of the courtyard. And I looked, and behold!—one hole in the wall.
And he said to me, “Son of man, now dig into the wall.” So I dug into the wall, and behold!—one entrance.
Then he said to me, “Enter, and see the evil abominations that they are doing here.”
So I entered, and I looked, and behold!—every form of crawling thing and detestable animal and all of the idols of the house of Israel, carved on the wall all around, all around.

And seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel (and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan was standing in their midst) were standing to their faces, and each man—his censer in his hand. And the smell of the cloud of incense was ascending.

Then he said to me, “Are you seeing, son of man, that which the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark—each man in the chambers of his picture? For they are saying, ‘Yahweh is not seeing us; Yahweh has abandoned the land.’”
And he said to me, “You will yet return; you will see {the} great abominations that they are doing.”
Then he brought me to the entrance of the gate of the house of Yahweh that {was} toward the north, and behold! There, the women were sitting, weeping for the Tammuz.
Then he said to me, “Are you seeing, son of man? Still, you will return; you will see greater abominations than these.”

So he brought me to the court of the house of Yahweh, the inner {one}, and behold! {At} the entrance of the temple of Yahweh, between the porch and between the altar—about 25 men, their backs toward the temple of Yahweh and their faces eastward, and they were prostrating themselves eastward to the sun.

Then he said to me, “Are you seeing, son of man? Is it too light for the house of Judah, doing the abominations that they have done here? For they have filled the land {with} violence, and they have returned to make me angry. And behold! They are sending the branch out to their nose!
And so I—I will act in heat. My eye will not pity, and I will not have compassion. And they will call out in my ears {with} a great voice, but I will not hear them.”
And he called in my ears {with} a loud voice, saying, “Draw near, executioners of the city, and each {with} the weapon of his destruction in his hand.”

And behold! Six men were coming from the way of the upper gate that faces northward, and each {with} {the} weapon of his smashing in his hand. But one man {was} in their midst, clothed in linen, and the equipment of the scribe {was} on his waist. And they came, and they stood beside the altar of bronze.

Then the glory of the God of Israel went up from over the cherub that it had been over it, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man, the {one} clothed in linen, whose equipment of the scribe {was} on his waist.

Then Yahweh said to him, “Cross through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem. And you shall mark a mark on the foreheads of the men, the {ones} groaning and the {ones} sighing over all the abominations that are being done in her midst.”
And to these, he said in my ears, “Cross through the city after him and strike. Do not let your eye pity, and do not spare!

Old {men}, young man and young woman and children and women you shall kill to destruction, but, to any man who on him {is} the mark, do not draw near. And from my sanctuary, you shall begin.” So they began with the elderly men who {were} to the face of the house.
And he said to them, “Make unclean the house, and fill the courts {with} the slain. Go out.” And they went out, and they struck in the city.

And it was, as they struck, that I myself remained. And I fell on my face, and I cried out, and I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Are you destroying the whole remnant of Israel when you pour out your heat against Jerusalem?”

Then he said to me, “The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is very, very great, and the land is filled {with} blood, and the city {is} full of corruption. For they say, ‘Yahweh has abandoned the land,’ and, ‘Yahweh is not seeing.’
And so I—my eye will not pity, and I will not have compassion. Their way I have placed on their head.”
And behold! The man clothed in linen, whose equipment {was} on his waist, was returning a word, saying, “I have done just as you commanded me.”
And I looked, and behold! To the vault that {was} over the head of the cherubim, like a stone of sapphire, {something} like the appearance of the likeness of a throne appeared over them.

And he said to the man clothed in linen, and he said, “Go to between the wheelwork, to under the cherub, and fill your handfuls {with} coals of fire from between the cherubim, and sow {them} over the city.” And he went to my eyes.
(And the cherubim were standing from the right of the house when the man went. And the cloud filled the inner courtyard.)

Then the glory of Yahweh arose from over the cherub to the threshold of the house. And the house was filled {with} the cloud, and the courtyard was filled {with} the brightness of the glory of Yahweh.
And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer courtyard, like the sound of the Almighty when he speaks.
And it was, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the wheelwork, from between the cherubim.” Then he went, and he stood beside the wheel.

Then the cherub sent his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that {was} between the cherubim, and he lifted {it}, and he gave {it} to the {two} handfuls of {the one} clothed in linen. Then he took {it}, and he went out.
(And of the cherubim was seen the form of a hand of a man under their wings.)

So I looked, and behold! Four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside the one cherub, and one wheel beside the one cherub. And the appearance of the wheels {was} like the eye of a stone of topaz.
And their appearance was one likeness for the four of them, as when the wheel is in the midst of the wheel.
When they went, toward four of their sides they went; they did not turn when they went. For the place where the head faced, after it they went; they did not turn when they went.
