And I will place my jealousy against you, so they will do with you in heat. Your nose and your ears they will remove, and your remainder will fall by the sword. They—your sons and your daughters they will take, and your remainder will be devoured by the fire.
And they will strip you of your garments, and they will take the vessels of your beauty.
And I will make your obscenity cease from you and your prostitution from the land of Egypt. Then you will not lift your eyes to them, and Egypt you will not remember again.’
For thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold me!—giving you into the hand of those whom you hated, into the hand of those who your soul turned away from them,

(and they will do with you in hatred, and they will take all your labor, and they will leave you, naked and bare; and the nakedness of your prostitutions will be uncovered, and your obscenity and your prostitutions)
doing these things to you in exchange for your prostituting after the nations, because you became unclean with their idols.
In the way of your sister, you have walked. So I will give her cup into your hand.’
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘The cup of your sister you will drink, the deep and the wide {one}; it will be for laughter and for mocking, containing much.
{With} drunkenness and sorrow, you will be filled—the cup of horror and desolation, the cup of your sister, Samaria.
And you will drink it, and you will drain {it}, and its shards you will gnaw, and your breasts you will tear; for I, I have spoken’—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Because you have forgotten me and you have thrown me behind your back, so you also—you will carry your obscenity and your prostitutions.”
Then Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominations.

For they have committed adultery, and blood {is} on their hands; and {with} their idols, they have committed adultery. And even their sons whom they bore to me they made pass through to them for food.
Still this they did to me: They made my sanctuary unclean on that day, and my Sabbaths they profaned.
And when they slaughtered their sons to their idols, then they came to my sanctuary on that day to profane it. And behold! Thus they did in the midst of my house.

And indeed, for they sent for men coming from a distance, who a messenger was sent to them; and behold! They came—{those} for whom you washed, you painted your eyes, and you adorned yourself {with} ornaments.
And you sat on a bed of glory, with a table was arranged to its face, and my incense and my oil you set on it.

And the sound of a multitude at ease {was} in her, and to the men from the multitude of humanity, drunkards were brought from the wilderness, and they put bracelets on their hands and a crown of beauty on their heads.
And I said of the one worn out {with} adulteries, ‘Now, he will prostitute her prostitutions, and she.’
And he went in to her as one goes in to a prostituting woman; thus they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the women of obscenity.
But righteous men—they will judge them {with} the judgment of adulteresses and {with} the judgment of {ones} pouring blood, for they are adulteresses, and blood {is} on their hands.
For thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Raise up against them an assembly, and give them to terror and to plunder.
And an assembly will stone them with stones, and they will cut them down with their swords. Their sons and their daughters they will kill, and their houses with fire they will burn.
So I will make obscenity cease from the land, and all the women will be warned, so they will not do according to your obscenity.
And they will put your obscenity on you, and the sins of your idols you will carry. Then you will know that I {am} the Lord Yahweh.’”
And the word of Yahweh was to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
“Son of man, write for yourself the name of the day, this very day. The king of Babylon has pressed against Jerusalem on this very day.
And speak a proverb to the house of rebellion, and you shall say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Set on the pot, set {it} on, and also pour into it water.
Gather its pieces into it, every good piece, thigh and shoulder; {with} the choicest of bones, fill {it}!
the choicest of the flock take, and also stack the bones under it. Boil its boilings; also its bones have boiled in its midst.”

Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Woe {to} the city of bloods, the pot that rust {is} in it, but the rust has not gone out from it! To its pieces, to its pieces, bring it out; a lot has not fallen on it.
For her blood is in her midst; on {the} bare surface of a rock, she placed it. She did not pour it on the ground, to cover over it {with} dust.
To make heat ascend, to avenge vengeance, I have put her blood on the bare surface of a rock, without it being covered.”
Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Woe {to} the city of bloodshed! Also I, I will grow the pile.
Multiply the wood, kindle the fire, finishing the flesh and mixing the spice mixture, and the bones—let them be burned.
And make it stand on its coals empty, so that it may become hot and its bronze may burn, and its uncleanness may be melted in its midst, its rust may come to an end.
It has made {itself} weary {with} toils, and the abundance of its rust has not gone out from it; into the fire {with} its rust!
In your uncleanness is depravity. Because I cleansed you but you were not clean, from your uncleanness you will not be clean again until I have caused my wrath to rest on you.

I, Yahweh, have spoken. It is coming, and I will do {it}. I will not refrain, and I will not have pity, and I will not relent. According to your ways and according to your deeds they have judged you’— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.”
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,
“Son of man, behold, I am taking from you the desire of your eyes with a plague. But you will not mourn, and you will not weep, and your tears will not come.

Groan, be silent; {for} the dead you will not make mourning. Bind your headdress on yourself, and put your sandals on your feet. And you will not cover over {your} mustache, and you will not eat the bread of men.”
And I spoke to the people in the morning, and my wife died in the evening. And I did in the morning as I was commanded.
And the people said to me, “Will you not tell us what these are to us, that you are doing {them}?”
And I said to them, “The word of Yahweh was to me, saying,

‘Say to the house of Israel, “Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, I am profaning my sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and the compassion of your soul. And your sons and your daughters whom you have left behind will fall by the sword.
And you will do as I have done. You will not cover over {your} mustache, and you will not eat the bread of men.
And your headdresses will be on your heads and your sandals on your feet. You will not mourn and you will not weep, but you will rot away in your iniquities, and you will groan, a man to his brother.
And Ezekiel will be for a sign to you; according to all that he has done you will do. When it comes, then you will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”’”

“And you, son of man, will it not be in the day of my taking from them their stronghold, the joy of their splendor, the desire of their eyes, and the lifting up of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
in that day the fugitive will come to you, to cause the ears to hear?
In that day your mouth will be opened to the fugitive, and you will speak and you will no longer be mute. And you will be for a sign to them, and they will know that I am Yahweh.”
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face to the sons of Ammon, and prophesy against them.

And you will say to the sons of Ammon, ‘Hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of your saying, ‘Aha!’ to my sanctuary because it was profaned, and to the land of Israel because it was desolated, and to the house of Judah because they went into exile—

therefore, behold, I am giving you to the sons of the east as a possession. And they will set their encampments in you, and they will put their dwellings in you. They, they will eat your fruit, and they, they will drink your milk.
And I will give Rabbah as a pasture of camels and the sons of Ammon as a resting place of flocks. And you will know that I am Yahweh.”
For thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of your clapping the hand and your stamping with the foot, and you rejoiced with all of your contempt in the soul to the land of Israel—

therefore, behold, I have stretched out my hand against you, and I will give you as plunder to the nations. And I will cut you off from the peoples, and I will make you perish from the lands. I will destroy you, and you will know that I am Yahweh.”
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of the saying of Moab and Seir, ‘Behold, the house of Judah is like all of the nations,’
therefore, behold, I am opening the shoulder of Moab from the cities, from his cities, from his end, the splendor of the land: Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim,
to the sons of the east along with the sons of Ammon. And I will give it as a possession, so that the sons of Ammon will not be remembered among the nations.
And against Moab I will do judgments, and they will know that I am Yahweh.”
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of the doing of Edom in avenging vengeance against the house of Judah, and they became guilty, being guilty, and they took vengeance on them”—

therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “I will stretch out my hand against Edom, and I will cut off from her man and beast. And I will make her a waste from Teman, and to Dedan they will fall by the sword.

And I will give my vengeance on Edom by the hand of my people Israel, and they will do in Edom according to my anger and according to my wrath. And they will know my vengeance”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Because of the doing of the Philistines in vengeance, and they avenged vengeance with contempt in the soul, for destruction {with} everlasting hostility”—
therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: “Behold, I am stretching out my hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites, and I will make the remnant of the shore of the sea perish.
And I will do great vengeances against them with rebukes of wrath. And they will know that I am Yahweh when I put my vengeance on them.”’”
Now it happened in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, ‘Aha! The doors of the peoples have been broken. She has been turned to me. I will be filled; she has been laid waste!’—
therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Behold, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up against you many nations, as the sea brings up its waves.
And they will destroy the walls of Tyre and tear down her towers. And I will scrape her dust from her, and I will make her as a bare surface of a rock.
A spreading place of nets she will be in the midst of the sea, for I, I have spoken’—‘the declaration of the Lord Yahweh. ‘And she will become plunder for the nations.
And her daughters who are in the field will be killed by the sword. And they will know that I am Yahweh.’

For thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Behold, I am bringing to Tyre Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon from the north, a king of kings, with horse and with chariot and with horsemen, and an assembly and a great people.
Your daughters in the field he will kill by the sword. And he will set a siege wall against you, and he will pour out a siege mound against you, and he will raise up a large shield against you.
And the blow of his battering ram he will set against your walls, and your towers he will break down with his swords.

From the abundance of his horses their dust will cover you. From the sound of horseman and wheel and chariot your walls will shake, when he comes into your gates like the entrances of a city broken open.
With the hooves of his horses he will trample all of your streets. Your people he will kill by the sword, and the pillars of your strength will go down to the ground.

And they will spoil your wealth and plunder your merchandise, and they will tear down your walls and break down the houses of your desire. And your stones and your wood and your dust they will put in the midst of the water.
And I will make the multitude of your songs cease, and the sound of your harps will not be heard again.
And I will give you as a bare surface of a rock. A spreading place of nets you will be. You will not be built again, for I, Yahweh, have spoken’— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh to Tyre: ‘Will not the coastlands shake from the sound of your fall, when the slain one groans, when slaughter is slain in your midst?

And all of the princes of the sea will come down from upon their thrones, and they will remove their robes, and they will strip off their garments of embroidery. Tremblings they will put on; on the ground they will sit, and they will tremble at moments, and they will be desolate over you.

And they will take up a lamentation over you, and they will say to you, “How you have perished, O inhabited one from the seas, the praised city, which was strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, who put their terror on all of her inhabitants!
Now the coastlands will tremble on the day of your fall, and the coastlands that are in the sea will be terrified from your going out.”’
For thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘When I make you a city laid waste, like the cities that have not been inhabited, when {I} bring up the deep over you and the many waters cover you,

then I will bring you down with the ones going down to the pit, to a people of eternity. And I will make you dwell in the land of the lower parts, like ruins from eternity, with the ones going down to the pit, so that you will not dwell {there}. And I will put splendor in the land of the living.
I will give you terrors, and you {will} be no more. And you will be sought, but you will not be found again forever’— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.”
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“And you, son of man, take up over Tyre a lamentation,
and you shall say to Tyre, the dweller at the entrances of the sea, the merchant of the peoples to many coastlands, thus says the Lord Yahweh: ‘Tyre, you, you have said, “I am perfect of beauty.”
In the heart of the seas are your borders; your builders perfected your beauty.
They built all of the planks for you with cypresses from Senir; they took a cedar from Lebanon to make a mast upon you.
They made oaks from Bashan {into} your oars; they made your deck {of} ivory, the daughter of Ashurim, from the coasts of Kittim.
Your sail was fine linen with embroidery from Egypt, to be for you as a banner; your covering was blue and purple from the coasts of Elishah.
The dwellers of Sidon and Arvad were rowers for you; your wise men, O Tyre, were in you; they were your rope-men.
The elders of Gebal and her wise men were in you, the strengtheners of your cracks. All of the ships of the sea and their sailors were in you to exchange your merchandise.
Persia and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war. Shield and helmet they hung in you; they, they gave your splendor.
The sons of Arvad and your army were on your walls all around, and Gammadim were in your towers. Their shields they hung on your walls all around; they, they perfected your beauty.
Tarshish was your trader from the abundance of all wealth; they gave your wares with silver, iron, tin, and lead.
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech, they, they were your merchants; with the soul of man and vessels of bronze they gave your merchandise.
From Beth Togarmah they gave horses and warhorses and mules {as} your wares.
The sons of Dedan were your merchants; many coastlands were the trade of your hand. They brought back horns of ivory and ebony {as} your gift.
Aram was your trader from the abundance of your works; with emerald, purple, and embroidery, and fine linen, and corals, and ruby they gave in your wares.
Judah and the land of Israel, they, they were your merchants; with wheat of Minnith and pannag and honey and oil and balm they gave your merchandise.
Damascus was your trader in the abundance of your works, from the abundance of all wealth, with wine of Helbon and wool of whiteness.
Vedan and Javan from Uzal gave in your wares; wrought iron, cassia, and cane were in your merchandise.
Dedan was your merchant with garments of covering for riding.
Arabia and all of the princes of Kedar, they, they were the traders of your hand; with lambs and rams and male goats, in them {were} your traders.
The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, they, they were your merchants; with the head of every spice and with every precious stone and gold they gave your wares.
Haran and Kanneh and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Assyria, {and} Kilmad were your merchant.
They, they were your merchants with choice garments, with wrappings of blue and embroidery, and with coverings of multicolored cloth bound with cords and made firm, in your marketplace.
The ships of Tarshish were your travelers {with} your merchandise. And you were filled and you became very heavy in the heart of the seas.
Into many waters the ones rowing you brought you; the wind of the east broke you in the heart of the seas.

Your wealth and your wares, your merchandise, your sailors and your rope-men, the strengtheners of your cracks and the ones exchanging your merchandise, and all of your men of war who are in you, and with all of your assembly that is in your midst, they will fall in the heart of the seas on the day of your fall.
At the sound of the cry of your rope-men the pasturelands will shake.
And all of the graspers of an oar will come down from their ships; the sailors, all of the rope-men of the sea, will stand on the land.
And they will make heard over you with their voice, and they will cry out bitterly, and they will bring up dust on their heads; in the ashes they will roll.
And they will make themselves bald for you {with} a baldness, and they will gird sackcloth, and they will weep for you in bitterness of soul, a bitter mourning.
And they will take up over you in their wailing a lamentation, and they will lament over you: “Who is like Tyre, like a silenced one in the midst of the sea?”
When your wares went out from the seas, you satisfied many peoples; with the abundance of your wealth and your merchandise you made rich the kings of the earth.
{At this} time {you} are broken from the seas, in the depths of waters, your merchandise and all of your assembly in your midst have fallen.
All of the dwellers of the coastlands are desolate over you, and their kings have shuddered a shudder; {their} faces have quaked.
Traders among the peoples hiss over you; terrors you have become, and you are no more forever.’”
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

“Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Because your heart has been high, and you have said, ‘I am God; {in} the dwelling of God I have dwelt in the heart of the seas,’ and you are man and not God, and you have given your heart as the heart of God.
Behold, you are wiser than Daniel; every hidden thing they have not darkened {from} you.
By your wisdom and by your understanding you have made for yourself wealth, and you have made gold and silver in your treasuries.
By the abundance of your wisdom, by your merchandise, you have increased your wealth, and your heart became high in your wealth.”
Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Because of your giving your heart as the heart of God—
therefore, behold, I am bringing against you strangers, the ruthless of the nations. And they will draw out their swords against the beauty of your wisdom, and they will profane your radiance.
They will bring you down to the pit, and you will die the deaths of a slain one in the heart of the seas.
Saying, will you say, ‘I am God,’ to the face of the ones killing you? And you are man and not God in the hand of the ones piercing you.
The deaths of uncircumcised ones you will die by the hand of strangers, for I, I have spoken”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.’”
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, take up a lamentation over the king of Tyre, and you shall say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “You were the one sealing a pattern, full of wisdom and perfect of beauty.

In Eden, the garden of God, you were. Every precious stone was your covering: ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, sapphire, emerald, and garnet; and gold. The work of your tambourines and your sockets was in you. In the day of your being created they were established.
You were a cherub of anointing, the one covering. And I placed you, you were on the mountain of the holiness of God; you walked about in the midst of the stones of fire.
You were blameless in your ways from the day of your being created until injustice was found in you.

They filled your midst {with} violence in the abundance of your merchandise, and you sinned. And I profaned you from the mountain of God, and I made you perish, O cherub, the one covering, from the midst of the stones of fire.
Your heart was high in your beauty; you corrupted your wisdom on account of your radiance. On the earth I threw you; to the face of kings I gave you, to look upon you.

From the abundance of your iniquities, in the injustice of your merchandise, you profaned your sanctuaries. And I brought out fire from your midst; it, it consumed you. And I gave you as ashes on the earth before the eyes of all the ones seeing you.
All of the ones knowing you among the peoples are desolate over you. You have become terrors, and you are no more forever.’”
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face against Sidon, and prophesy against her.

And you shall say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in your midst. And they will know that I am Yahweh when I do judgments in her and I am sanctified in her.
And I will send into her plague and blood in her streets, and the slain one will fall in her midst by the sword against her from all around. And they will know that I am Yahweh.
And there will no longer be for the house of Israel a pricking brier and a thorn causing pain from all of those around them, the ones despising them. And they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”

Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “When I gather the house of Israel from the peoples among whom they were scattered, and I am sanctified in them before the eyes of the nations, then they will dwell on their dirt that I gave to my servant, to Jacob.

And they will dwell on it in security, and they will build houses and plant vineyards. And they will dwell in security when I do judgments on all of those despising them from around them. And they will know that I am Yahweh their God.”’”
In the tenth year, in the tenth {month}, on the twelfth of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against Egypt, all of it.

Speak and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I am against you, Pharaoh king of Egypt, the great sea monster lying in the midst of his rivers, who said, ‘To me {is} my Nile, and I, I have made myself.’

And I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will make the fish of your rivers cling to your scales. And I will bring you up from the midst of your rivers, and all of the fish of your rivers will cling to your scales.

And I will cast you out to the wilderness, you and all of the fish of your rivers. You will fall on the face of the field; you will not be gathered, nor will you be gathered together. I have given you as food to the living thing of the land and to the bird of the heavens.
And all of the inhabitants of Egypt will know that I am Yahweh, because of their being a staff of reed for the house of Israel.
When they grasped you by your palm, you were crushed, and you split open for them every shoulder. And when they leaned on you, you were broken, and you made all of their loins shake.”
Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I am bringing against you a sword, and I will cut off from you man and beast.
And the land of Egypt will become a desolation and a ruin. And they will know that I am Yahweh, because he said, ‘The Nile is mine, and I, I have made {it}.’
Therefore, behold, I am against you and against your rivers, and I will make the land of Egypt into ruins of devastation, a desolation, from Migdol {to} Syene and as far as the border of Cush.
The foot of man will not pass through it, and the foot of beast will not pass through it, and it will not be inhabited 40 years.

And I will make the land of Egypt a desolation in the midst of desolated lands, and her cities will be a desolation in the midst of cities laid waste, 40 years. And I will scatter Egypt among the nations and disperse them among the lands.”
For thus says the Lord Yahweh, “From the end of 40 years I will gather Egypt from the peoples where they were scattered.
And I will restore the fortunes of Egypt, and I will bring them back {to} the land of Pathros, to the land of their origin. And they will be there a lowly kingdom.
It will be the lowliest from the kingdoms, and it will not lift itself up again over the nations. And I will make them few, so as not to rule over the nations.
And it will no longer be for the house of Israel as a confidence, bringing iniquity to remembrance when they turned after them. And they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”’”
And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, in the first {month}, on the first of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

“Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon made his army serve a great service against Tyre. Every head was made bald, and every shoulder was made bare. But there were no wages for him and for his army from Tyre for the service that he served against her.

Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘Behold, I am giving to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon the land of Egypt. And he will carry away her multitude, and he will plunder her plunder, and he will spoil her spoil. And it will be wages for his army.
{As} his wages for which he served against her, I have given to him the land of Egypt, because they did {it} for me’— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
In that day I will make a horn sprout for the house of Israel, and I will give an opening of mouth to you in their midst. And they will know that I am Yahweh.”
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Wail, ‘Alas for the day!’
For a day is near, and a day is near for Yahweh, a day of cloud; a time of nations it will be.
And a sword will come into Egypt, and there will be anguish in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt, and they take her multitude, and her foundations are torn down.
Cush and Put and Lud and all the mixed company and Cub, and the sons of the land of the covenant with them— by the sword they will fall.”
Thus says Yahweh, “And the supporters of Egypt will fall, and the pride of her strength will go down. From Migdol {to} Syene they will fall by the sword in her”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
“And they will be desolated in the midst of desolated lands, and his cities will be in the midst of cities laid waste.
And they will know that I am Yahweh when I put fire in Egypt and all of her helpers are broken.
In that day messengers will go out from my face in ships to make Cush tremble {in its} security, and there will be anguish among them in the day of Egypt; for behold, it is coming.”
Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “And I will make the multitude of Egypt cease by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon.
He and his people with him, the ruthless of the nations, are being brought to destroy the land. And they will draw out their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
And I will make the rivers dry ground, and I will sell the land into the hand of evil ones, and I will make the land and its fullness desolate by the hand of strangers.” I, Yahweh, have spoken.

Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “And I will make idols perish, and I will make worthless idols cease from Memphis, and there will no longer be a prince from the land of Egypt. And I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
And I will make Pathros desolate, and I will put fire in Zoan, and I will do judgments in On.
And I will pour out my wrath on Sin, the fortress of Egypt, and I will cut off the multitude of On.
And I will put fire in Egypt. Writhing Sin will writhe, and On will be for being broken open, and Memphis {will have} adversaries by day.
The young men of Aven and Pi Beseth will fall by the sword, and they, they will go into captivity.
And in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark, when I break there the yokes of Egypt, and the pride of her strength will cease in her. She, a cloud will cover her, and her daughters will go into captivity.
And I will do judgments in Egypt, and they will know that I am Yahweh.”’”
Now it happened in the eleventh year, in the first {month}, on the seventh of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh the king of Egypt. And behold, it has not been bound up, to give medicines, to put a bandage to bind it up, for it to be strong to grasp the sword.
Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, ‘Behold, I am to Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and I will break his arms, the strong one and the broken one, and I will make the sword fall from his hand.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will disperse them among the lands.
And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and I will put my sword in his hand. And I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan the groanings of a slain one to his face.

And I will make strong the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh will fall. And they will know that I am Yahweh when I put my sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he stretches it out against the land of Egypt.
And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will disperse them among the lands. And they will know that I am Yahweh.’”
Now it happened in the eleventh year, in the third {month}, on the first of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, say to Pharaoh the king of Egypt and to his multitude, ‘To whom are you like in your greatness?
Behold, Assyria was a cedar in Lebanon, beautiful of branch and a forest giving shade and high of height, and among the thick boughs was its top.
Waters made it great; the deep made it high, with its rivers going around its planting, and its channels it sent out to all the trees of the field.
Therefore its height was higher than all of the trees of the field, and its limbs became many, and its boughs grew long from many waters in its sending out.
Every bird of the heavens nested in its limbs, and every beast of the field gave birth under its boughs, and all of the many nations dwelt in its shade.
And it became beautiful in its greatness, in the length of its branches, for its root was by many waters.
Cedars did not darken it in the garden of God; cypresses were not like its limbs, and plane trees were not like its boughs. Not any tree in the garden of God was like it in its beauty.
I made it beautiful, in the abundance of its branches, and all the trees of Eden that were in the garden of God envied it.
Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Because it was high in height, and it set its top among the thick boughs, and its heart was high in its height,
and I gave it into the hand of a mighty one of the nations; doing he did to it. According to its wickedness I drove it out.

And strangers, the ruthless of the nations, cut it down and they abandoned it. Its branches fell on the mountains and in all the valleys, and its boughs were broken in all the channels of the land. And all the peoples of the land went down from its shade and abandoned it.
Every bird of the heavens would dwell on its ruin, and every beast of the field was at its boughs,

so that all the trees of waters will not be high in their height, and they will not set their top among the thick boughs, and their mighty ones will not stand in their height— all of the drinkers of waters. For all of them have been given to death, to the lower land, in the midst of the sons of man, to the ones going down to the pit.”

Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “In the day of its going down to Sheol I caused mourning. I covered the deep over it, and I withheld its rivers, and many waters were restrained. And I made Lebanon dark over it, and all the trees of the field were faint over it.

I made nations quake from the sound of its downfall, in my bringing it down to Sheol with the ones going down to the pit. And all the trees of Eden were comforted in the lower land, the choicest and good of Lebanon, all of the drinkers of waters.
They also, with it, went down to Sheol, to the slain of the sword, and its arm— they dwelt in its shade in the midst of the nations.

To whom are you thus like, in glory and in greatness, among the trees of Eden? But you will be brought down with the trees of Eden to the lower land. In the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie down with the slain of the sword. That is Pharaoh and all of his multitude”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.’”
Now it happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

“Son of man, take up a lamentation over Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and say to him, ‘You were likened to a young lion of the nations, but you are like the sea monster in the seas. And you burst forth in your rivers, and you stirred up the waters with your feet, and you muddied their rivers.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “And I will spread my net over you in an assembly of many peoples, and they will bring you up in my dragnet.

And I will throw you on the land; I will hurl you on the face of the field. And I will make every bird of the heavens dwell on you, and I will make the living thing of all the land satisfied from you.
And I will put your flesh on the mountains, and I will fill the valleys with your carcass.
And I will make the land of your outflow drink from your blood, to the mountains, and the channels will be filled from you.
And I will cover the heavens at your extinguishing, and I will make their stars dark. The sun, with a cloud I will cover it, and the moon will not make its light shine.
I will make all of the luminaries of light in the heavens dark over you, and I will put darkness on your land”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
“And I will provoke the heart of many peoples to anger in my bringing your breaking among the nations, to lands that you have not known.

And I will make many peoples desolate over you, and their kings will shudder a shuddering over you, in my making my sword fly over their faces. And they will tremble for moments, a man for his soul, in the day of your downfall.”
For thus says the Lord Yahweh, “The sword of the king of Babylon will come to you.
I will make your multitude fall by the swords of warriors, the ruthless of the nations, all of them. And they will devastate the pride of Egypt, and all of her multitude will be destroyed.
And I will make all of her beasts perish from beside many waters, and the foot of man will not stir them up again, and the hooves of a beast will not stir them up.
Then I will make their waters settle, and their rivers I will make go like oil”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
“In my making the land of Egypt a desolation, and a land desolated from its fullness, in my striking all of the inhabitants in her— then they will know that I am Yahweh.
A lamentation it is, and they will lament it. The daughters of the nations will lament it; over Egypt and over all of her multitude they will lament it”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.’”
Now it happened in the twelfth year, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, wail over the multitude of Egypt, and bring it down, it and the daughters of majestic nations, to the lower land, with the ones going down to the pit.
‘Than whom are you more pleasant? Go down and be laid down with the uncircumcised!’
In the midst of the slain of the sword they will fall. A sword has been given; draw her out and all of her multitudes.
The mighty ones of the warriors will speak to him from the midst of Sheol with his helpers, ‘They have gone down; they lie, the uncircumcised, the slain of the sword.’
There is Assyria and all of her assembly; all around him are his graves, all of them slain, the fallen by the sword,
whose graves have been given in the recesses of the pit, and her assembly is all around her burial place, all of them slain, falling by the sword, who had given terror in the land of the living.

There is Elam and all of her multitude, all around her burial place, all of them slain, the fallen by the sword, who went down uncircumcised to the lower land, who had given their terror in the land of the living. And they bore their humiliation with the ones going down to the pit.

They have given a bed for her in the midst of the slain among all of her multitude; all around him are her graves. All of them are uncircumcised, slain of the sword, for their terror was given in the land of the living, and they bore their humiliation with the ones going down to the pit. He has been put in the midst of the slain.
There are Meshech, Tubal, and all of her multitude; all around him are her graves. All of them are uncircumcised, pierced ones of the sword, for they had given their terror in the land of the living.

And they do not lie with the warriors, the ones falling from among the uncircumcised, who went down to Sheol with the weapons of their war. And they put their swords under their heads, and their iniquities were on their bones, for the terror of warriors was in the land of the living.
And you, in the midst of the uncircumcised you will be broken, and you will lie with the slain of the sword.
There is Edom, her kings and all of her leaders, who have been given, in their might, with the slain of the sword. They, they will lie with the uncircumcised and with the ones going down to the pit.

There are the princes of the north, all of them, and every Sidonian, who went down with the slain, ashamed in their terror from their might. And they lay uncircumcised with the slain of the sword, and they bore their humiliation with the ones going down to the pit.
Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all of his multitude— the slain of the sword, Pharaoh and all of his army”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

“For I have given his terror in the land of the living, and he will be laid down in the midst of the uncircumcised, with the slain of the sword— Pharaoh and all of his multitude”— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

“Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and say to them, ‘When I bring a sword against a land, and the people of the land take one man from their number and give him to themselves as a watchman,
and he sees the sword coming against the land and blows on the shofar and warns the people,
and the hearer hears the sound of the shofar and is not warned, and a sword comes and takes him— his blood will be on his head.
The sound of the shofar he heard, and he was not warned; his blood will be on him. But {if} he, being warned, he saves his life.

But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow on the shofar, and the people are not warned, and a sword comes and takes a life from them— he, he is taken in his iniquity, but his blood I will demand from the hand of the watchman.’
And you, son of man— a watchman I have given you for the house of Israel. And you will hear a word from my mouth, and you will warn them from me.

When I say to the wicked one, ‘Wicked one, dying you will die,’ and you do not speak to warn the wicked one from his way— he, the wicked one, will die in his iniquity, but his blood I will seek from your hand.
But you, if you warn a wicked one from his way, to turn back from it, and he does not turn back from his way— he, he will die in his iniquity, but you, you have delivered your soul.
And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus you have said, saying, “Surely our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and in them we are rotting away. And how shall we live?”’

Say to them, ‘The life of me’— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh—‘if I delight in the death of the wicked one, but rather in the turning back of a wicked one from his way, so that he lives. Turn back, turn back from your evil ways! And why should you die, house of Israel?’

And you, son of man, say to the sons of your people, ‘The righteousness of the righteous will not deliver him in the day of his transgression, and the wickedness of the wicked— he will not stumble by it in the day of his turning back from his wickedness. And a righteous one will not be able to live by it in the day of his sinning.

When I say to the righteous, “Living he will live,” and he, he trusts in his righteousness and does injustice— all his righteousness will not be remembered, and in his injustice that he did, in it he will die.
When I say to the wicked, “Dying you will die,” and he turns back from his sin and does justice and righteousness—
the wicked returns a pledge, he repays robbery, he walks in the statutes of life, so as not to do injustice— living he will live; he will not die.
All his sin that he sinned will not be remembered for him. He has done justice and righteousness; living he will live.
But the sons of your people say, “The way of the Lord is not fair,” but they, their way is not fair.
In the turning back of a righteous one from his righteousness, and he does injustice— then he will die in them.
And in the turning back of a wicked one from his wickedness, and he does justice and righteousness— because of them he, he will live.
But you say, “The way of the Lord is not fair.” A man according to his ways I will judge you, house of Israel.’”
Now it happened in the twelfth year of our exile, in the tenth {month}, on the fifth of the month, the fugitive came to me from Jerusalem, saying, “The city has been struck.”

Now the hand of Yahweh was to me in the evening, to the face of the coming of the fugitive, and he opened my mouth until the coming to me in the morning. And my mouth was opened, and I was not mute any longer.
And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,
“Son of man, the dwellers of these ruins on the land of Israel are saying, saying, ‘Abraham was one, and he possessed the land, but we are many; to us the land has been given as a possession.’
Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: You eat upon the blood, and you lift up your eyes to your idols, and you shed blood—and will you possess the land?
You have stood upon your sword; you have done an abomination; and a man, the wife of his neighbor you have defiled— and will you possess the land?’

Thus you will say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “The life of me, if not that they will fall by the sword in the ruins, and that I will give him on the face of the field to the living thing to eat him, and that they will die by the plague in the strongholds and in the caves.
And I will make the land a desolation and a waste, and the pride of her strength will cease, and the mountains of Israel will be desolate, from there being no one passing over.
And they will know that I am Yahweh, when I make the land a desolation and a waste on account of all their abominations that they did.’

And you, son of man— the sons of your people, the ones speaking with one another about you beside the walls and in the entrances of the houses, and one speaks with one, a man with his brother, saying, ‘Come, please, and hear what the word is that is going out from Yahweh.’

And my people come to you like the coming of a people, and they sit to your face, and they hear your words, but them they do not do. For lusts in their mouth they, they are doing; after their gain their heart is going.
And behold, you are to them like a song of lusts, beautiful of voice and doing well {at} playing. And they hear your words, but they are not doing them.
And in its coming— behold, it is coming— then they will know that a prophet has been in their midst.”
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,

“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and you shall say to them, to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Woe, shepherds of Israel who have been shepherding themselves! Should not the shepherds shepherd the flock?
The fat you eat, and the wool you wear; the fat one you slaughter. The flock you do not shepherd.

The weak ones you have not strengthened, and the sick one you have not healed, and the broken one you have not bound up, and the one driven away you have not brought back, and the perishing one you have not searched for. And with force you have subjugated them, and with harshness.
And they scattered without a shepherd, and they became food for every living thing of the field, and they scattered.
My flock stray on all of the mountains and on every high hill, and over all of the face of the land my flock were scattered, and there is no one seeking, and there is no one searching.
Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of Yahweh:

{By} my life—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh—If {it is} not because of my flock becoming prey, and my flock has become food for every living thing of the field from there being no shepherd, and my shepherds did not seek my flock, and the shepherds shepherded themselves and they did not shepherd my flock—
therefore, shepherds, hear the word of Yahweh:

Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold me, against the shepherds! And I will seek my flock from their hand, and I will cause them to cease from shepherding the flock, and the shepherds will no longer shepherd themselves. And I will deliver my flock from their mouth, and they will not be food for them.
For thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold me, me, I will seek my flock, and I will attend to them.

Like the attending of a shepherd of his flock in the day of his being in the midst of his scattered flock, thus I will attend to my flock. And I will deliver them from all of the places which they were scattered there in a day of cloud and thick darkness.

And I will bring them out from the peoples, and I will gather them from the lands, and I will bring them to their land. And I will shepherd them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams and in all of the dwelling places of the land.

In a good pasture I will shepherd them, and on the mountains of the height of Israel their habitation will be. There they will lie down in a good habitation, and a fat pasture they will graze among the mountains of Israel.
I, I will shepherd my flock, and I, I will make them lie down—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

The perishing one I will search for, and the one driven away I will bring back, and the broken one I will bind up, and the sick one I will strengthen. But the fat {one} and the strong {one} I will destroy. I will shepherd it with justice.
And you, my flock, thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold me, judging between a sheep and a sheep, {between} the rams and the male goats.

{Is it} too little for you {that} you graze the good pasture, and the rest of your pastures you trample with your feet, and you drink the settled waters, and the remaining ones with your feet you muddy?
And my flock, the trampling of your feet they graze, and the muddying of your feet they drink.
Therefore, thus says the Lord Yahweh to them: Behold me, me, I will judge between a fat sheep and between a lean sheep,
because with side and with shoulder you push, and with your horns you gore all of the weak ones, until you have scattered them to the outside.
And I will save my flock, and they will no longer be plunder, and I will judge between a sheep and a sheep.
And I will raise up over them one shepherd—and he will shepherd them—my servant David. He, he will shepherd them, and he, he will be the shepherd to them.
And I, Yahweh, will be God to them, and my servant David {will be} a prince in their midst. I, Yahweh, have spoken.
And I will cut for them a covenant of peace, and I will cause the harmful living thing to cease from the land. And they will dwell in the wilderness in security, and they will sleep in the forests.
And I will make them and the surroundings of my hill a blessing, and I will bring down the rain in its time. Rains of blessing they will be.

And the tree of the field will give its fruit, and the land will give its produce, and they will be on their land in security. And they will know that I {am} Yahweh in my breaking of the bars of their yoke and I will deliver them from the hand of the ones enslaving on them.
And they will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the living thing of the land will not eat them. And they will dwell in security, and there will be no one making {them} afraid.
And I will raise up for them a planting for a name, and they will no longer be gathered ones of famine in the land, and they will no longer bear the humiliation of the nations.
And they will know that I, Yahweh their God, {am} with them, and they {are} my people, the house of Israel—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.
And you {are} my flock, the flock of my pasture. You {are} man. I {am} your God—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.’”
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,
“Son of man, set your face against Mount Seir, and prophesy against it.
And you shall say to it, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold me against you, Mount Seir! And I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you a desolation and a wasteland.
Your cities I will make a ruin, and you, you will be a desolation. And you will know that I am Yahweh.
Because of there being to you an everlasting hostility, and you poured out the sons of Israel onto the hands of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end—
therefore, {by} my life—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh—that I will make you for blood, and blood will pursue you. If you did not hate blood, but blood will pursue you.
And I will make Mount Seir a desolation and a desolation, and I will cut off from it the one crossing over and the one returning.
And I will fill his mountains with his slain ones. Your hills and your valleys and all your streams—the slain of the sword will fall in them.
Everlasting desolations I will make you, and your cities will not be inhabited. And you will know that I am Yahweh.
Because of your saying, “The two nations and the two lands, to me they will belong, and we will possess it,” and Yahweh was there—

therefore, {by} my life—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh—I will act according to your nose and according to your jealousy that you did out of your hatreds against them. And I will make myself known among them just as I judge you.
And you will know that I {am} Yahweh. I have heard all your blasphemies that you said against the mountains of Israel, saying, “They are desolate; to us they have been given for food.”
And you magnified {yourselves} against me with your mouth, and you multiplied your words against me. I, I have heard.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Like the rejoicing of all the earth, a desolation I will make for you.

Like your rejoicing over the inheritance of the house of Israel because it was desolate, thus I will do to you. A desolation you will be, Mount Seir, and all Edom, all of it. And they will know that I {am} Yahweh.’”
“And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and you shall say, ‘Mountains of Israel, hear the word of Yahweh!
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because the enemy has said against you, “Aha!” and, “The eternal high places have become to us as a possession,”’

therefore prophesy and you shall say, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because, indeed because, of desolating and panting for you from all around, for your being a possession to the remnant of the nations, and you were taken up on the lip of the tongue and the evil report of a people,

therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord Yahweh! Thus says the Lord Yahweh to the mountains and to the hills, to the streams and to the valleys, and to the desolate ruins and to the forsaken cities that have become plunder and scorn to the remnant of the nations that are all around—

therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: If not in the fire of my jealousy I have spoken against the remnant of the nations and against Edom, all of it, who gave my land to themselves as a possession with the joy of all the heart, with contempt in the soul, for the sake of its pastureland, for plunder.’

Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel and you shall say to the mountains and to the hills, to the streams and to the valleys, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold me, in my jealousy and in my wrath I have spoken, because you have borne the humiliation of nations.
Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: I, I have lifted up my hand—if not the nations that are around you, they, they will bear their humiliation.
But you, mountains of Israel, you will give your branch, and you will bear your fruit for my people Israel, for they have drawn near to come.
For behold me for you, and I will turn to you, and you will be worked and you will be sown.
And I will multiply man on you, all the house of Israel, all of it. And the cities will be inhabited, and the ruins will be built.

And I will multiply on you man and beast, and they will multiply and be fruitful. And I will cause you to dwell as in your former times, and I will do good more than in your beginnings. And you will know that I am Yahweh.
And I will cause man to walk on you, my people Israel, and they will possess you, and you will be to them as an inheritance, and you will not repeat again to be bereaved of them.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Because they are saying to you, “A devourer of man you are, and a bereaved one of your nation you have been,”
therefore man you will not devour again, and your nation you will not cause to stumble again— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.

And I will not cause you to hear the insult of the nations again, and the reproach of the peoples you will not bear again, and your nation you will not cause to stumble again— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh.’”
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,
“Son of man, the house of Israel was dwelling on their ground, and they defiled it with their way and with their actions. Like the uncleanness of menstruation was their way to my face.
And I poured out my wrath on them because of the blood that they poured out on the land, and with their idols they defiled it.
And I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed among the lands. According to their way and according to their actions I judged them.
And he came to the nations which they came there, and they profaned the name of my holiness, when to say of them, ‘These {are} the people of Yahweh, but from his land they went out.’
And I had compassion on the name of my holiness, which the house of Israel profaned it among the nations which they came to there.

Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Not for your sake am I acting, house of Israel, but rather for the name of my holiness, which you profaned among the nations which you came there.

And I will sanctify my great name, the one profaned among the nations, which you profaned in their midst. And the nations will know that I {am} Yahweh—the declaration of the Lord Yahweh—when I am sanctified through you to their eyes.
And I will take you from the nations, and I will gather you from all the lands, and I will bring you to your ground.
And I will sprinkle on you clean water, and you will be clean from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols I will cleanse you.
And I will give to you a new heart, and a new spirit I will put in your inward part. And I will remove the heart of stone from your flesh, and I will give to you a heart of flesh.
And my Spirit I will put in your inward part, and I will do that which in my statutes you will walk, and my judgments you will keep and do.
And you will dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers, and you will be to me as a people, and I, I will be to you as God.
And I will save you from all your uncleannesses, and I will call to the grain and I will multiply it, and I will not put famine on you.
And I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you will not receive again the reproach of famine among the nations.
And you will remember your evil ways and your actions that {were} not good, and you will feel loathing in your faces because of your iniquities and because of your abominations.
Not for your sake am I acting— the declaration of the Lord Yahweh— may it be known to you. Be ashamed and be humiliated because of your ways, house of Israel!
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: On the day of my cleansing you from all of your iniquities, then I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the ruins will be built.
And the desolated land will be worked, in place of which it was a desolation to the eyes of everyone passing by.
And they will say, “This here desolated land has become like the garden of Eden, and the ruined and the desolated and the torn-down cities {are} fortified; they are inhabited.”
And the nations that are left around you will know that I, Yahweh, have built the torn-down {places}; I have planted the desolated {place}. I, Yahweh, have spoken, and I will do {it}.
Thus says the Lord Yahweh: Again for this I will be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do for them: I will multiply them like a flock of man.
Like a flock of holy {ones}, like the flock of Jerusalem at her appointed times, thus the ruined cities will be full of a flock of man. And they will know that I {am} Yahweh.’”
The hand of Yahweh was upon me, and he brought me out by the Spirit of Yahweh and placed me in the midst of the valley, and it {was} full of bones.
And he made me pass over them around, around, and behold, {they were} very many upon the face of the valley, and behold, they {were} very dry.
And he said to me, “Son of man, can these bones live?” And I said, “Lord Yahweh, you, you know.”
And he said to me, “Prophesy over these bones, and you shall say to them, ‘O dry bones, hear the word of Yahweh!’
Thus says the Lord Yahweh to these bones, ‘Behold, I am bringing breath into you, and you will live.
And I will put sinews upon you, and I will bring up flesh upon you, and I will spread skin over you, and I will put breath in you, and you will live. And you will know that I {am} Yahweh.’”
And I prophesied just as I was commanded. And there was a sound as I prophesied, and behold, a rattling! And the bones drew near, bone to its bone.
And I looked, and behold, sinews {were} upon them, and flesh came up, and skin spread over them from above, but there was no breath in them.

And he said to me, “Prophesy to the breath! Prophesy, son of man, and you shall say to the breath, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “From the four winds come, O breath, and breathe into these killed ones, so that they may live.”’”
And I prophesied just as he had commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, a very, very great force.
And he said to me, “Son of man, these bones, they {are} all the house of Israel. Behold, they are saying, ‘Our bones have dried up, and our hope has perished. We are cut off to ourselves.’
Therefore prophesy and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I {am} opening your graves, and I will bring you up from your graves, my people, and I will bring you to the soil of Israel.
And you will know that I am Yahweh when I open your graves and when I bring you up from your graves, my people.
And I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live, and I will set you upon your soil. And you will know that I, Yahweh, I have spoken and I have done {it}”’”— the declaration of Yahweh.
And the word of Yahweh was to me, saying,

“And you, son of man, take for yourself one wood and write on it, ‘For Judah and for the sons of Israel, his companion.’ And take one wood and write on it, ‘For Joseph, the wood of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel, his companion.’
